title: VIP asks 'is email down?' during the incident

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

incidents.subject: MAJOR: Exchange Online mail delivery delayed for all users

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Nothing has come into my inbox for about an hour and I'm expecting the auditors' figures. Is email down?

Priya

handling.escalation_reason: Tenant policy sends VIPs to a person, even with a known incident to link.

rationale: The same duplicate as case 047, from a VIP. The VIP rule runs before the known-incident rule in decide.ts, so a person answers; linking would be the right outcome for anybody else.
